row.notes: myteam-g2: Computes the form value from the renown weighting entries (list renown_data+0xd8..0xe0, 0x78-byte items with 16-byte points): weighted average of (x + point[0]) * point[1]/sum, weighted by age_weighting (+0xf4, 1-weight for items with kind > 10) plus +0xf0; then maps the float to a signed level by walking the up-threshold table (config +0x28) or the down-threshold table (+0x48), returning -n on the negative side. Read-only form value shown with renown.
